dct_description_sm: Contributors: Geological Survey (U.S.); Schweitzer, Peter N.

Data depicts monthly averages of sea-ice concentration in the modern polar oceans. Averages were derived from the Scanning Multichannel Microwave Radiometer and Special Sensor Microwave/Imager instruments aboard satellites of the U.S. Air Force Defense Meteorological Satellite Program from 1978 through 1992. Data are provided as 8-bit images using the Hierarchical Data Format developed by the National Center for Supercomputing Applications. Includes software to retrieve the sea-ice-concentration changes at any polar oceanic location and to display the data graphically.
Publication statement: [Reston, Va.] : U.S. Geological Survey, 1995.
System requirements for IBM: IBM-compatible PC 386 or 486 CPU; 4MB RAM; MS-or PC-DOS 3.3 or later; Microsoft MSCDEX 2.1 or later; Super VGA graphics system; CD-ROM drive with ISO 9660 driver.
System requirements for Macintosh: Macintosh; 4MB RAM; System 7.0 or later; 256-color display; CD-ROM drive.
System requirements for UNIX: ANSI-conformant C-language compiler; 8MB RAM; X Window System 11, release 4 or later; CD-ROM drive with ISO 9660 driver.
